items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: And I worked with his son George at one job there and I knew George for years

ctx.x: Well I know you would have gone for a while. What about bands like Schilling? Did you know Hacker Schilling then?
Yeah I knew the old man, yeah I knew him. And I worked with his son George at one job there and I knew George for years, like later on I used to lead him down in the union and stuff like that.
And Fisher, Johnny Fisher, did you know him? Johnny Fisher?
